name: Stateful tests
statusMessage:
1. Test Case ID: rsVFMZ

- Use after free

    The API did not return a `HTTP 404 Not Found` response (got `HTTP 200 OK`) for a resource that was previously deleted.

    The resource was deleted with `DELETE /api/colors/9`

[200] OK:

    `{"name":"9","hex":"#D05c29"}`

Reproduce with:

    curl -X GET -H 'Content-Type: application/json' http://127.0.0.1:5001/api/colors
    curl -X PUT -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{"hex": "#D05c29", "name": "9"}' http://127.0.0.1:5001/api/colors/9
